quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the intensity of playoff basketball
quotes.excerpt: It's a whole different atmosphere. It's fun, it's competitive.
quotes.quote: Playoff basketball was great. That was my first time being there since my rookie year, so I'm always grateful for that. It's a whole different atmosphere. It's fun, it's competitive. So that's why I'm saying congrats to the Knicks because I know how hard it is to win games in the playoffs, so they were able to do it at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu compares Noah and Naz Reid's development
quotes.excerpt: Noah and Naz have different games. Noah is very good though. Naz, he's been playing like a big jelly.
quotes.quote: I don't think Noah and Naz have the same games. Noah is very good though. Naz, he's been playing like a big jelly since we were in the same class since we were young. He always had the erky jerky. Noah is going to be very good. He gives me like Pascal Siakam vibes.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu's expectations for Caleb Williams in Chicago
quotes.excerpt: I think Caleb Williams is going to be very good in Chicago. I think he's going to be very good.
quotes.quote: I think Caleb Williams is going to be very good in Chicago. I think he's going to be very good.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on player development after injury
quotes.excerpt: I think Noah is going to bounce back very good.
quotes.quote: I think Noah is going to bounce back very good. If you look at a lot of the guys in history who were drafted and then the next year they got hurt, they tend to do well because now he understands the speed of the game and his mind is a little bit ahead of his body. So now when he's playing out there, he's kind of going to have an advantage.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu's perspective on NBA officiating in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: I think they really took away a lot of flopping and I think it was a good game.
quotes.quote: The refereeing in the Finals was cool. Shout out to all the refs in the NBA, they did a great job in the Finals. I think they really took away a lot of flopping and I think it was a good game and I don't think none of the games really came down to the refs. I think it came down to the Knicks and Spurs, you know, battling and the better team winning.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu's future career aspirations in NBA management
quotes.excerpt: I would definitely want to be a probably a GM.
quotes.quote: It's far in the future, but would you want to be a coach or work in a front office after playing? I would definitely want to be a probably a GM.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the Bulls' injury-plagued season
quotes.excerpt: When Victor elbowed Naz, what was I thinking? That shit was on some damn like he got elbowed.
quotes.quote: When Victor elbowed Naz, what was I thinking? That shit was on some damn like he got elbowed. I was more surprised that Naz didn't really go off. I told Naz that I appreciate him for not doing what he I knew he really wanted to do. He showed self-control and growth. Very proud of him.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the difficulty of guarding elite NBA players
quotes.excerpt: It's tough. The NBA is nothing but tough guys in the NBA. It ain't even no.
quotes.quote: Me versus Ant, we never played, but ask Ant, he know how I get. That's my guy. It's tough. The NBA is nothing but tough guys in the NBA. It ain't even no. The NBA is full of tough, tough, good players. Everywhere, you got great players everywhere, man.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the prevalence of flopping in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Flopping is a part of the game though, you got to come with it. It is what it is.
quotes.quote: Flopping is a part of the game though, you got to come with it. It is what it is. It can do be a lot of flopping going on, but people be fouling. I'm talking about fouling and he don't get no foul. A lot of people in the NBA be fouling, you know, because people be so good on offense and there's a lot of pick and rolls and they they they they moving so fast. The pace is up at an all-time high, so you have to foul. So when you get called for a foul, you know, some offensive players, they understand that and they using it to their advantage. Flopping and good flopping is a skill.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on adjusting to new team systems
quotes.excerpt: It's all the same stuff. It's just different different terminology.
quotes.quote: I want to say it was hard. It's just all that's all the same stuff. It's just different different terminology. So it wasn't hard at all.
